scope: Independent root review of r20 Bionic statfs compatibility fix in the exact Android ELF
findings: Core delta preserves all original guards. It clears only kernel-private ST_VALID (0x0020), only under __BIONIC__, after successful Read and before publishing the Snapshot; errno restoration and error returns remain unchanged.
The exact Android Read contains the negative-result branch at 0x4c5d, byte AND with -0x21 at 0x4c63, then copies the complete 0x1ad8-byte Snapshot at 0x4c7a. Other flag bits are preserved.
Start at 0x36e0 has one clone call at 0x3a6a to trampoline 0x3450, Worker 0x3fa0, null context, flags 0x350900, parent/clear-tid address 0x260d4.
The entire trampoline uses the aligned private stack and clone/exit syscall sites. Actual audited worker closure remains only Worker, ReadContext and SameContext.
R19's ten actual failures all differed only in f_flags (native 0 versus raw 32). R20 keeps the same metadata test source and comparisons.
